facts.value: Internal action-state entry routine with signature void(Fighter_GObj* gobj). It obtains the associated Fighter through GET_FIGHTER, clears allow_interrupt, and forwards gobj to motion-state and animation helpers; allocation and destruction ownership are not established by this routine.
facts.rationale: Preserves the supported signature and parameter role while removing the unproved assertion that gobj owns the Fighter. A lookup, field mutation and forwarding do not establish ownership.

evidence.why: The static declaration establishes internal linkage and the signature.
The complete body establishes Fighter lookup, flag mutation and object forwarding, but contains no allocation or destruction ownership evidence.
